body.p: by the review agent (), after , , , . Checked locally (): tools/check-main.sh on a clean HEAD (84f3178) builds , debug (ASan, UBSan), debug-gcc and wasm; every test passes but two of the XSLT driver (xslt/list_dependencies, xslt/run_json): 4.17's numbering commit 50a3651 made "CIRCLED DIGIT ONE" a supported combination and the goldens still skip it (Phase 4, 4.17's files; told to the orchestrator). The full lint reports three findings, none in Phase 3 code: a bare bool parameter in tests/xslt/driver/xslt_assertion.c, a byte pointer without length in src/xslt.c (4.15) and a null dereference the analyzer finds in src/xslt_read.c (4.16); no call cycle.

item.p: Numbers (code of 50a3651, , tools/run-qt4.sh and tools/run-xslt.sh, every test set finished, 0 crashes, no leak reported by the drivers' budgets): XP40 30,646 of 47,313 passed (as at the Phase 2 gate: no regression), 0 errors, in scope 30,628 of 31,543, 97.1 %. XQ40 40,025 passed, 0 errors, in scope 40,007 of 41,174, 97.2 %; XQ-only 9,404 of 9,523, 98.8 %; method-* 433 of 508 (85.2 %; 97.5 % of the 444 run). Slices: qt4/slice 198/198, qt4/xquery-slice 186/186 (ctest, all presets). XT40 for the record: 7,693 of 13,867 passed, in scope 88.1 %, 7 errors (Phase 4).

Fuzzing, 300 s per target, all six at once on a loaded machine: cast_fuzz 434,140 runs, regex_fuzz 174,843, xml_parse_fuzz 26,453, xpath_compile_fuzz 5,517, xpath_evaluate_fuzz about 2,100 and the new xquery_fuzz about 2,400 (fork mode); no crash, leak or sanitizer report. One xquery_fuzz timeout, a QT4 seed that loops 200,001 times building a map each time: slow by nature under ASan (P9), listed for triage only, as for xpath_evaluate_fuzz.

through function pointers: the evaluator's guard holds (); fn:load-xquery-module runs its module on the same machine (EVALUATE_UNIT, ), compilation inside a native step runs a lowering machine of its own lowerer, which never evaluates. The lowering machine now refuses to run while one of the same lowerer runs (is_running in sxml_xpath_lowerer, SXML_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT), 's follow-up: every test passes, so no step of XQuery or XSLT lowering starts a machine. Serializers and tree builders call no evaluator.

Merged (conceptual smallness): one in-place heapsort, sxml_sort_in_place (src/sort_internal.h), instead of the copies in src/xquery_static.c (prolog checks), src/xquery_parse.c (attribute names of a direct constructor), src/evaluator_global.c (initializer order) and src/xslt_output.c (character maps); one parameter document reader, sxml_parameter_document_load with sxml_processor_compile_document_loader_initialize (src/processor_internal.h), for XQuery's output:parameter-document and xsl:output's and xsl:result-document's parameter-document (two loaders and two document-element walks removed). With every change of this review, XP40 outcomes are identical case by case (release, every test set) and XQ40 gains five (fn-function-lookup-759, -760, -762, -763 and fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xquery, below), losing none: 40,030 passed; XT40 differs only in the package sets that 4.16 changed meanwhile (accept, override, use-package, expose, ...), none in the output and serialization sets.

Fuzzing XQuery: tests/fuzz/xquery_fuzz.c compiles, evaluates and serializes a main module through xquery.h alone, on a processor with small limits and a resolver table with one library module and one document; seeds are the QT4 queries and .xq files (tools/fuzz-seeds.py); it runs in fork mode like xpath_evaluate_fuzz (tools/fuzz.sh).

xquery.h is stable ('s rule): consistent with xpath.h and xslt.h (memory_requirements, initialize, finalize, create, destroy; configuration and request structs), every declaration documented, every function tested through the public API with an allocation-failure loop (tests/xquery_test.c), the CLI on it alone. From now on it changes as every public header does (). The one behaviour still open is the owner's: XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default (, Proposed); choosing "no" changes the header's comment with a record. version.h, docs/RELEASE.md and CHANGELOG.md say so.

Proposed, resolved here: hintless imports of a namespace with several modules (): the contract is kept (XQuery 4.0, 5.12 leaves the set of modules implementation-defined; two QT4 cases fail). The prolog follow-ups ( (b'), (h); 's "Not done") are accepted as designs for a later sweep, no owner decision: a fixed default is a default function without focus parts whose value the evaluation memo keeps; fn:function-lookup passes the call's focus as hidden arguments that may be absent. Left for the owner: the three WebAssembly budgets, XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default; for Phase 4: the XSLT functions at run time, 's and 's items.

Delayed features (): each is rejected or ignored in one place with the specification's error: XQuery's validate (XQST0075, src/xquery_lower.c), schema import (XQST0009, src/xquery_static.c), %updating (XQST0045, the reserved-namespace check of src/xquery_static.c), update and full-text syntax (XPST0003, the grammar), UCA with fallback=no (FOCH0002, src/collation.c alone; the evaluator and xsl:for-each-group pass its error on), named time zones (FODT0004, src/function_library_temporal.c), calendars and languages of dates (src/format_date.c: "[Calendar: AD]", "[Language: en]") and of numbers (English words and ordinals in src/function_library_format.c, for fn:format-integer and xsl:number alike), fn:parse-html, fn:html-doc, invisible XML, fn:transform, xsd-validator and EXPath (not in the library: XPST0017), DTD validation and XInclude options (FODC0013, the shared option reader), streaming (streamable is read only where a non-streaming processor must read it: xsl:mode's properties, accumulator scope; source documents are built whole). Fixed: fn:load-xquery-module was known to static calls only (XQuery's function table lived for one compilation), so fn:function-lookup did not find it and supports-dynamic-xquery of fn:system-properties said false; the query now keeps that table and gives it to its evaluations (the unit evaluation extension), and the property asks the dynamic context's table (XQ40 fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xquery passes; XPath still says false, rightly). Scattered or missing (XSLT, files in flight for 4.16 and 4.17, so listed, not merged): the processor's capabilities are two tables, fn:system-properties (src/function_library_json.c) and xsl:system-property (src/function_library_xslt.c), which should be one; XTSE1660 is raised for default-validation strict or lax in src/xslt_read.c but not for validation="strict"/"lax" or type attributes of instructions, and xsl:import-schema is read and ignored instead of raising XTSE1650 (XSLT 4.0, 25: a non-schema-aware processor raises both, at the attribute reader, one place); backwards-compatible behaviour (version below 3.0) is not detected at all, where XSLT 4.0, 3.9 asks XTDE0160 of a processor without it.

Follow-ups (not done here; the files are 4.16's and 4.17's): the XSLT lowering files keep their own copies of small helpers (a heapsort in src/xslt_lower_declaration.c and src/xslt_lower_template.c, resolve_declared_type three times, slot_atom nine times across XQuery and XSLT, add_expression seven); XML whitespace trimming is written about fifteen times (trim_whitespace, trim_spaces, ...); grouping keys compare in both src/xquery_flwor.c and src/xslt_group.c. Each is small; one shared helper each, at the Phase 4 gate at the latest.
